header.running_head: The Practices of Nabi ﷺ and the Sahabah (RA) with Regard to Clothing

Hadhrat Muhammad narrates that he once asked Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA), "What was Rasulullaah ﷺ's bedding like in your home?" She replied, "It was made of leather and stuffed with the bark of a date palm." When he then posed the same question to Hadhrat Hafsah (RA), she replied, "Rasulullaah ﷺ used to sleep on a coarse sheet that we double-folded. One night I thought to myself that it would be more comfortable if I four-folded it (so I did that). The following morning, Rasulullaah ﷺ asked, 'What did you spread down for me last night?' 'It was the same bedding,' I explained, 'all that I did was to four-fold it so that it would be more comfortable for you.' Rasulullaah ﷺ said, 'Leave it as it was because its softness prevented me from performing salaah last night.'" [^2]
What Rasulullaah ﷺ Recited when Wearing New Clothing
Hadhrat Umar (RA) reports that he saw Rasulullaah ﷺ send for some new clothing. When it reached his collar-bone as he was putting it on, he recited:

blocks.arabic_text: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيْ كَسَانِيْ مَا أُوَارِيْ بِهِ عَوْرَتِيْ وَأَتَجَمَّلُ بِهِ فِيْ حَيَاتِيْ
blocks.text: "All praise is for Allaah Who has given me clothing to conceal my private areas and with which I can look beautiful in this life."

Rasulullaah ﷺ then said, "I swear by the Being Who controls my life! When a Muslim wears new clothing, recites these words and then purely for Allaah's pleasure gives the old clothes that he is removing to a poor person, he will remain in the care, the security and the protection of Allaah as long as there remains even a single thread of the garment left (on the poor person). This applies whether he is alive or dead. This applies whether he is alive or dead." [^3]

Hadhrat Ali (RA) reports that he was sitting with Rasulullaah ﷺ near (the graveyard of) Baqee on a rainy day when a woman passed by on her donkey, carrying a heavy load. As she passed through a depression in the ground, she fell off the donkey. Rasulullaah ﷺ turned his face away (so as not to see her body as it became exposed because of the fall). When someone informed Rasulullaah ﷺ that the lady was wearing trousers (because of which her body did not become exposed), Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "O Allaah! Forgive all the women of my Ummah who wear trousers." Addressing the Sahabah (RA), Rasulullaah ﷺ then said, "O people! Always wear trousers because it is amongst the most concealing of clothing. Ensure that you protect your women with it whenever they go out." [^4]
Hadhrat Hasan bin Arafah. Ibn Sa'd (Vol.1 Pg.465) has reported a similar narration.
